title: 14mm Multi-purpose Whip Adapter
description:
14mm Multi-purpose Whip Adapter
The 14mm Whip Adapter is a handy little accessory capable of connecting many devices to the 14mm female joint of a water pipe. It can also be used in the 14mm outlet of water pipes as a whip for inhalation.
Many devices use a similar sized mouthpiece so there is a good chance this whip will work for you. Simply stretch the silicone tubing over the mouthpiece and connect the other end to your water pipe.
This whip adapter is made up of two main parts. One being the glass 14mm male joint and the other being a medical grade silicone tubing which is approximately 40cm long.
Included
1 x 14mm Multi-Purpose Whip Adapter
